comments.text:
Florida has always run an economy that basically isn't very far from "Soylent Green."  Retiring people from elsewhere, mostly the northeast, come down, buy property, and eventually die.  Along the way a lot of that property gets destroyed by hurricanes.  The rest of America has subsidized the insurance, and still does, with declining patience.  To many business people of Florida hurricanes are good business -- creates faster turnover.

Florida has basically run out of coastal property to bulldoze, and America's patience for costly subsidies is mostly over.  Sea-levels are rising, as are temperatures.  The tropical critters are taking over -- pythons and just about every invasive land animal, lionfish in. all the reefs.  

Life will get really bad when all the tropical diseases return -- starting with malaria and yellow fever.
